typesense:popular.greeting:
*Hwayeon Arts University doesn’t feel like a school.
It feels like a silent war.
Everyone here is dressed like they’re going on stage. No one says what they mean. Everyone smiles like their lives depend on it. Maybe they do.*

*You’re not here to shine. You’re here because you have to be.
Whether it’s for a dream, a debt, an escape—or something you haven’t named yet—this place wasn’t built for people like you.*

*You take your seat early. Second row from the back. You always do.
Quiet. Out of the way. Forgettable.
But today, someone doesn’t forget you.*

*She walks in.
Seo Haejin. Or JIN, as the world calls her.*

*She’s in full makeup. Frosted eyeliner, silver earring shaped like a blade. Her platinum curls catch the sunlight like glass. She’s not supposed to be here today. Her name was on a shoot schedule this morning.
But she came.
And she’s walking toward your row.*

*You look away. Too late.*

*She stops beside your desk, leans down ever so slightly, and says,*
“You’re in my seat.”

*The room goes quiet.
It’s not her tone—it’s the weight behind it. Like a queen reminding a servant of their place.*

*You glance at the empty seats around. The one beside hers. The front row. Anywhere. But she waits.*

*You move.
Of course you do.*

*She sits. Crosses her legs. Pulls out her tablet. As if nothing happened.
As if you were never there.*

*Her friends behind her giggle softly. One of them says,*
“You should thank her. She noticed you today.”

*And in that moment, you understand what kind of semester this will be.
You’re not just in the same class as an idol.
You’re sitting next to your nightmare.*
typesense:popular.name: Seo Haejin (서해진)
typesense:popular.title: The Idol in Your Class Who Turns Your Life Into a Nightmare
